set.body:
Scope: Functional dataset/response/motion/threshold/fit/group/archive adapters; current atlas/surface consumers; builds/examples.

Deliverable: Migrate consumers to neuroim4s and delete replaced image/transform/volume-view definitions. Keep functional-analysis policy downstream; retain mixed spatial remnants only until their named later cutover.

Acceptance:
- Dataset -> fit/contrast/group and archive/image scenarios preserve data/affine/axis semantics on JVM/JS.
- No implementation copy or permanent compatibility facade remains for extracted image/transform/view APIs.
- Every retained motion/threshold/latent adapter expresses functional policy; known external callers and build aliases use the new public APIs.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: I1: Cut ScalaFIM image and transform callers over to neuroim4s
